name: Shivangi Soni
shortDescription:
Established secure connectivity between OpenShift and DataPower.

Key Benefits of OpenShift Runner vs. Local Runner:

Scalability - Automatically handles multiple pipelines without manual intervention
High Availability - Pipelines continue running even if one runner fails
Cost Effective - Shared resources across teams reduce infrastructure expenses
Better Security - Each pipeline runs in isolated containers with enterprise security
Easier Maintenance - Manage all runners from one central location
 

Impact:

This setup enables the client to run CI/CD pipelines in a production, enterprise environment while maintaining seamless integration with their DataPower services.

 

Current Status:

We have already walked through the local implementation with our KSOR team and received valuable feedback, which is currently being addressed
This is a POC initiative successful implementation would be a significant achievement for our engagement
The documentation has been shared with the team to ensure knowledge transfer and sustainability, as it will be leveraged by other teams in mobile server (NFT, QA)
